_how_to_switch_on: When the owner has verified a feature in a published release: set "verified": true and "release": "<version>" (no leading v, must exist in release.json) on its entry, check the copy below against the real behaviour, then run node apps/website/build.mjs. Both fields move together or the build fails. The entry then appears in the "What's new" list of that release on the site, in English and Arabic.
_rule: Nothing here is rendered while verified is false. Do not mention these features in README, site or release notes before then.

features.text_en: Magnet links and .torrent files download in the same list as everything else.
features.text_ar: روابط المغناطيس وملفات .torrent تُنزَّل في القائمة نفسها مع بقية التنزيلات.

features.text_en: Describe what you are looking for and pick from the files Riptide finds. Nothing downloads until you choose it.
features.text_ar: صف ما تبحث عنه واختر من الملفات التي يجدها Riptide. لا يبدأ أي تنزيل قبل أن تختاره.

features.text_en: The window controls and the app header share one bar, in light and dark.
features.text_ar: أزرار النافذة وترويسة التطبيق في شريط واحد، في الوضعين الفاتح والداكن.
